newsitem.title: USA: CME November lumber up limit on technical demand.
newsitem.headline: CME November lumber up limit on technical demand.

text.p: November CME lumber futures ran up the $10.00 per tbf daily limit at midsession on further technical demand, traders said.
November was up the limit at $350.90 per tbf with January up $9.30 at $359.00. Other months were up $8.40 to $6.00 per tbf.

Futures held technical support after testing the $339 to $340 support level early in November. Prices then rallied from those losses with buy stops cited early. Unwinding of bear spreads added to gains in the nearbys, traders said.
